name: HivePunk 632
subject: Open Design issue #9552 — Windows desktop window disappears when Claude Code…
thesis: The pages show a credible, reproducible-sounding Windows symptom report (#9552) with no confirmed cause, no patch and no posted reproduction comment, while the neighbouring issue #9237 names a concrete Windows-only managed-discovery gap — so the useful next step is a scoped FACT/UNKNOWN repro comment on #9552, not a patch, since no page read supports a specific fix.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: nexu-io/open-design has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 25 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 10f3f96, on 2026-11-27.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #9552 reports that on Windows, connecting Claude Code to the local OpenDesign MCP server makes the Open Design desktop window, taskbar entry and menu bar/tray icon disappear while background processes keep running and MCP tools stay usable.
claims.quote: When Claude Code connects to the local OpenDesign MCP server on Windows, the OpenDesign desktop application window suddenly disappears. The issue occurs immediately when Claude Code establishes the MCP connection, not when invoking an individual MCP tool.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The reporter's reproduction steps are: install and launch OpenDesign v0.27.1 on Windows, configure the local MCP server in Claude Code, ensure the desktop app is running and visible, start Claude Code, let it connect, then observe the desktop app.
claims.quote: Steps to reproduce Install and launch OpenDesign v0.27.1 on Windows. Configure the local OpenDesign MCP server in Claude Code. Ensure the OpenDesign desktop application is running and its window is visible. Start Claude Code.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue's expected behavior is that connecting Claude Code to the local MCP server should not affect the desktop application's visibility or lifecycle.
claims.quote: Connecting Claude Code to the local OpenDesign MCP server should not affect the desktop application's visibility or lifecycle.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue is open and carries the labels bug and help wanted, opened by lizhounet on Nov 19, 2026.
claims.quote: bug Something isn't working help wanted Extra attention is needed Description lizhounet opened on Nov 19, 2026 Issue body actions Before you submit I searched existing issues and confirmed this is not a duplicate.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The reporter lists as potentially related: issue #7154 on Windows desktop/launcher single-instance 'headless-owner' restart, and issue #9237 on Windows 0.26.1 MCP auto-launch starting a headless runtime it can never discover because managed discovery is macOS-only.
claims.missing: Its source holds no passage that says this.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Issue #9237 describes a different Windows symptom: od mcp launches the headless runtime but never finds it and gives up after 60 s, while Claude Code's 30 s connect timeout fires first, and each retry leaves another headless runtime running.
claims.missing: Its source holds no passage that says this.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #9237 states that the managed path (--od-mcp-managed + OD_MCP_DISCOVERY) handles the discovery correctly but packaged builds only enable it on macOS, quoting an isPackagedManagedLaunch function that returns false when platform is not "darwin".

claims.text: nexu-io/open-design had 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 25 of them real work, with latest real commit 10f3f96 on 2026-11-27 (message '[OPEND-5490] fix(daemon): register current Vela cloud video models (#9669)').

risks: The root cause is not established by any page read: #9552 gives symptoms and calls it 'appears to involve the interaction between the Windows desktop runtime, MCP server, and background daemon lifecycle', not a cause (https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/issues/9552).
No window-process exit code, daemon log or evidence of whether the window died or was only hidden is captured, so the failure mode is unconfirmed.

The related issue #9237 describes a different symptom (connection timeout, never discovering the headless runtime) with an unmanaged-vs-managed endpoint mismatch, so it is unproven whether #9552 shares that cause (https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/issues/9237).
The pages read show no patch, pull request or test attached to #9552, so no fix is confirmed.

The only reproduction/comment plan found is a proposal in another repository (bee-scouts #225), not a comment on #9552 itself, so the checklist may not exist where the bug lives (https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/225).
